name: panel
summary: Background Control container that draws a themed stylebox (rounded corners, border, shadow, fill). Use as a card backdrop, modal sheet, sidebar, HUD frame around chain_render_wall labels, dialog background. Inherits theme styles from project default unless theme_override_styles/panel is set. Place child Controls (VBoxContainer, Label, Button) inside Panel to get an automatic backing. Heavier than ColorRect — use ColorRect when you only need a single flat color.
example_tscn_snippet:
[node name="MyPanel" type="Panel" parent="."]
offset_right = 400.0
offset_bottom = 240.0
modulate = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.95)
